text: The accepted secure-mail test creates a PromiseCopyListener for each fixture and awaits its promise after copyFileMessage. That orders folder population before the message-selection loop. The test imports the CA/recipient certificate and OpenPGP key and registers cleanup rather than using a fabricated MIME body. This fixture lifetime contract is local to the browser test; no copy or key import was executed. These are fixed accepted source and test-code observations. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint, live accessibility or crypto/TLS validation ran.
title: Await message copy completion before selecting a secure fixture
